nodes.name: Vertex Gemini
nodes.notes: Vertex AI, not AI Studio. Vertex runs under the Google Cloud terms: prompts are not used to train models and are not read by human reviewers, which the AI Studio free tier explicitly allows. This carries real patient assessments. Replace REPLACE_WITH_GCP_PROJECT_ID in the URL with your project id. Region asia-southeast1 (Singapore) is the nearest to Sorsogon; change it in BOTH places in the URL if you use another. thinkingBudget 0 disables gemini-2.5-flash's reasoning pass: thinking tokens are charged against maxOutputTokens, so a 512 budget can be spent reasoning and return truncated JSON that fails to parse - which looks like a model failure, not a config one. This call ranks a pre-filtered list; it does not need to think. Credential: Google Service Account with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
